title: A New Heart
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler of warm hugs and warm hearts, and tonight the Lord promises to take out a heart of stone and give a soft, living heart, which is exactly the turn Willow feels at bath time when her tight, cold chest loosens and she hands her brother the good boat.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because a soft, warm heart is what she cares about most. In Willow’s world today: Willow stayed mad at her brother all afternoon and would not look at him. Her chest felt tight and cold. At bath time something loosened, and she handed him the good boat without being asked. Just like Heavenly Father’s promise of a new heart, Willow learned that He can turn a hard feeling soft.
